ask_text: Add the missing phase-entry guard test cells: undatable status.json records (#43) and the tiers column plus the tier-less record (#45). Both are test-only additions to the gate-phase-entry suite.

events.note: Standard tier folds the map into the BA Phase 1 dispatch; BA writes map.json alongside spec.json. risk_tier is pre-seeded here as standard so the tier-less refusal that issue #45 documents does not fire on our own first turn.

Tier PROMOTED to architectural by BA and accepted by the owner. No mandatory trigger fired (domains do not intersect data/security/compliance, no migration); this is a judgment promotion on the grounds that a halting control gains a behavioural change.
Round 1. SecOps blocks on spec grounds, not security: gating the 1-ba row on a resolved tier makes it unreachable at the only visit where map.json can still be missing. Looping back to BA.

Six blockers cleared, #61 filed with AC11 asserting the guard header cites it so the deferral is greppable. BA found a third stale figure nobody named (test-voice-lint asserted 41, is 48). ACs 11 -> 12, at the ceiling.

Round 2 clear, no REQUEST_CHANGES, so the convergence budget's split/defer/proceed decision was not triggered. Two reviewers independently found AC11 vacuous; a targeted BA criterion fix runs before Phase 2.5 so the falsifiability gate does not bounce it at Phase 3 entry.

Round-2 notes folded. AC11 rewritten with four clauses plus what the fix itself fails to bind; AC8/AC10 namespaced to end the label collision; every permanent-comment citation now quoted text or symbol plus a DISCRIMINATING re-derivation command.

owner_decision.required=false, no material divergence: both sketches agreed on mechanism, crux, state count and prohibition. Judge caught two false passes in its OWN method, including a walk reporting IDENTICAL while comparing three empty files.

Panel round 1. Two REQUEST_CHANGES; BA's blocker dismissed by the orchestrator against this run's own committed history, QA's upheld. No veto. Fix round is prose plus one assertion tightening, then a delta re-review of QA and SecOps.
delta re-review: qa secops ba dba. devops and the dev lens carry forward, neither objected and both had their notes marked resolved. panel_roles unchanged.
Delta round clear. Merge conditions outstanding: DBA's anchor major (third wrong wording of one sentence), 4 unwritten deferrals, the staleness-ceiling issue, and one-line nits from QA/BA/SecOps/DBA.

PR #62 rebase-merged as bc67abe; #43 and #45 closed. Suite green on main at 2216. The final nit round rejected the reviewer's proposed wording as false for the re-entry shape and shipped a corrected version.
Librarian dispatched non-blocking; the run is terminal at dispatch time, not on its return.
